text: Databases store and organize information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways, such as documents. To get information from a database, we write queries. Data modeling helps us plan how to structure the data before we build the database. Indexes make searches faster, like an index in a book. Choosing the right database and design depends on your needs.
